title: UNC won't have recruits at home opener, due to 2025 infraction

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: UNC won't have recruits at home opener, due to 2025 infraction
sources.description: Earlier this week, while being peppered with questions about the ongoing investigation at the North Carolina football program, Tar Heels coach Bill Belichick pointed to "our high standard here of our code of conduct and doing things the right way."
